evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet descriptor import logic across 'src/wallet/wallet.cpp' and 'src/wallet/imports.cpp'.
rationale: Closes long-standing issue #27336 by removing the requirement to expose private key material over RPC when importing descriptors into a wallet that already holds the keys. The author notes that previously 'importing a descriptor to a wallet that has private keys requires the descriptor to include the private keys', forcing users to handle sensitive keys manually.
